answer: Join-puzzle pricing makes each new identity burn compute. A key enters only by solving a memory-hard puzzle, the spiral, whose cost doubles after every 100 joins in an epoch, so the 101st key pays twice the first. The bridge, a public join queue, admits 200 keys per epoch and nobody skips it, and nectar rewards go only to keys that cleared it. Attacker pays: at $0.02 per early puzzle and $0.04 per later one, 200 fakes cost 100x0.02 + 100x0.04 = $6 this epoch.
